title: Shared component contract from what the NERV dashboard migration produced
goal: Once nerv:F-130 has produced them, the components that really repeat (status rows, cards, approval cards, fleet and battery views) are listed with their inputs and outputs
acceptance: Each candidate component names where it exists today in NERV, Grover and FPVBuddy and its inputs, outputs and tokens; one used by a single project is left out
Fleet and battery views name the NERV and FPVBuddy data they show
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: read the migrated NERV components and the matching FPVBuddy and Grover views. Not a measurement.
